name: Amazonis Planitia
description: Approximately 100 km sample of low-relief Amazonis plains near 19 N, 203 E.
limitations: Native MOLA MEGDR topography includes upstream interpolation where no MOLA shots exist; no per-cell observation mask is supplied.
128 pixels per degree (about 463 m) is grid spacing, not verified effective resolution.
Equirectangular grid: east-west ground spacing at the 19 N centre is about 438 m versus 463 m north-south.
Deliberately low-relief smooth-plains sample (about 178 m of relief across about 100 km); flat or low-information terrain cautions are expected and similarity is descriptor-only.

Extraction used a local PDS3 label copy and a generated ENVI companion header; the crop was verified pixel-exactly against the local MEGT44N180HB.IMG (MEGDR v2.0), whose SHA-256 is recorded in metadata.json.
